# peakhour_transform_settings (Resource)

Manages transform settings (HTML/image processing) for a domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "peakhour_transform_settings" "example" {
  domain                   = "example.com"
  transform_image_optimise = true
  transform_image_format   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Domain name.

### Optional

- `transform_beacon` (Boolean) Enable beacon injection.
- `transform_esi` (Boolean) Enable Edge Side Includes (ESI).
- `transform_html` (Boolean) Enable HTML transformation.
- `transform_http_header_value` (String) HTTP header value for transforms.
- `transform_image_api` (Boolean) Enable image transformation API.
- `transform_image_format` (Boolean) Enable automatic image format conversion.
- `transform_image_optimise` (Boolean) Enable image optimization.
- `transform_image_quality` (Number) Image quality (1-100).
- `transform_img_dims_to_query_args` (Boolean) Convert image dimensions to query arguments.
- `transform_lazy_sizes` (Boolean) Enable lazy loading for images.
- `transform_mixed_content` (Boolean) Fix mixed content (HTTP/HTTPS).
- `transform_rewrite_domains` (List of String) Domains to rewrite in transformed content.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Transform settings identifier.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import peakhour_transform_settings.example example.com
```
